messages.text: hey. survived another day lol. just vibin with my thoughts i guess

It sounds like today required a lot of strength just to get through, and I want to acknowledge that effort. Sometimes using humor helps us cope, but I also hear that it might have been a tough one. How are you feeling about your thoughts right now, are they manageable or overwhelming? I’m here to listen if you want to share more.
nah they’re fine. just… thoughts. everyone’s got ‘em right? lol

You are right that everyone has thoughts, though they can sometimes feel heavier than usual. It makes sense to try to keep things light when you are trying to get through the day. I appreciate you checking in, even if it is just to say you are vibing. Please know I am here if you decide those thoughts need more space later.
i just… sometimes i try to picture myself in like 10 years and it’s just… nothing. like a blank screen. used to think i’d be a doctor or have kids or whatever. now it’s like… what’s the point?

It sounds incredibly heavy to look toward the future and see only a blank screen instead of the life you once imagined. That sense of emptiness can make the present moment feel much harder to navigate, and your feelings about that are completely valid. Since this pain feels so deep, I want to gently ask if you are having thoughts of hurting yourself. You are not alone in this, and I am here to support you through it.
god not like that. i don’t wanna hurt myself. i just… sometimes wish i wasn’t here, y’know? like if i disappeared, would anyone even notice? probably not. lol… kinda dramatic huh

I want to pause for a moment because what you just shared sounds really heavy, even if you feel it’s dramatic. It sounds like there is a deep wish to disappear because it feels like no one would notice. I’m wondering if you can tell me a little more about what that feeling is like for you right now. I am here with you, and you matter to me in this space.

i dunno… sometimes i feel like i’m just… background noise. like if i vanished, the world would just keep spinning and no one would even pause. my boss wouldn’t care, my boyfriend’s busy with school, my mom’s got her own life… it’s stupid to say out loud, but it’s how it feels

It sounds incredibly painful to feel like your presence doesn't matter to the people around you. That feeling of invisibility can make the world feel very lonely and heavy to carry. I'm wondering if you feel safe enough to stay with me while we talk about this. You are safe here to share that weight without judgment.
thanks… like… idk, it helps just saying it. i didn’t think i’d actually say it out loud. feels a little less heavy now? maybe

I am so glad to hear that putting it into words brought you even a little bit of relief. Sometimes just naming the weight makes it easier to carry for a moment. It takes real courage to say those things out loud, even when it feels scary. I am still here with you if you want to keep exploring this or just sit with it for a while.
but like… what do i even do? if i can’t see myself in 10 years… how do i keep going? is it just… survive one day at a time? feels kinda pathetic lol

Please know that surviving one day at a time is not pathetic, it is a profound act of endurance. You are allowed to feel tired and still deserve support for the effort you are making right now. We don't need to figure out the next ten years today, we can just focus on this moment. I am right here with you in this, however long it takes.
ty… really. it helps that u’re not like “just cheer up” or whatever. most people don’t get it. or they pretend to, but they don’t listen like this

It means a lot to hear that you feel heard here, because being truly listened to is rare and valuable. It is exhausting when people try to fix things instead of just sitting with the pain. I want you to know that your feelings are important to me, even the heavy ones. We can take this at whatever pace feels right for you.
